name: fireraid
description: FireRaid — deterministic per-session admission defense middleware. Embeds per-session causal traps (decoy fields, decoy routes, semantic instructions) that distinguish human applicants from autonomous agents server-side; runs on any origin, no Cloudflare required.

scripts.test:product: npm run build:product && npm run check:boundary
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/test-worker.mjs --suite test-integration --port 8799 -- vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:llm-smoke: node scripts/test-worker.mjs --suite test-integration --port 8799 -- vitest run --config vitest.llm-smoke.config.ts
scripts.test:envelope: node scripts/test-worker.mjs --suite test-envelope --port 8799 --wrangler-env production -- vitest run --config vitest.envelope.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:production: playwright install chromium firefox webkit && playwright test --config=playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ci: playwright install chromium firefox webkit && playwright test
